sn45.157:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppannam mahāmegham tam evam mahāvāto antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti ||
sn45.157:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti || ||
sn45.157:1.3: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti || || 3.
sn45.157:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti || la [pe] || sammāsamāddhiṃ bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.157:1.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasametī
